en: A vintage black-and-white postcard depicting a natural grotto surrounded by lush vegetation and trees. In the center, there is a stone structure framed by large rocks. The overall style and printing suggest an early 20th-century design. Text in both Portuguese and French is present, identifying the site as Camões Grotto. The bottom of the postcard contains additional printed information including references to Macau and colonial Portugal.
